scripts.sync-codelab: (test -f ../codelab/index.html || ../codelab/.venv/bin/python ../codelab/build.py || python3 ../codelab/build.py) && mkdir -p public/codelab/lessons public/codelab/reference public/codelab/assets && cp ../codelab/index.html public/codelab/ && cp ../codelab/lessons/*.html public/codelab/lessons/ && cp ../codelab/reference/*.html public/codelab/reference/ && cp ../codelab/assets/* public/codelab/assets/
scripts.predev: npm run sync-casts && npm run sync-codelab
scripts.prebuild: npm run sync-casts && npm run sync-codelab
scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p dist/6 && cp dist/index.html dist/6/index.html && cp ../LICENSE ../FORK-NOTES.md dist/ && touch dist/.nojekyll
